solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Leaves half of silt in warehouses

indicators.note: in tells us the half-word goes inside the word for storage buildings

parts.note: depots are warehouses or storage buildings

indicators.note: half of takes just the front two of the four letters of silt

explanation.surface: Sediment from a river ends up stored in some warehouses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaves' is the verb here: to leave behind, as a river leaves silt. SI, the first half of silt, goes inside DEPOTS.
explanation.definitionFit: To deposit something is to set it down and leave it, so deposits and leaves are synonyms as verbs.

clue.text: Plunged Heads of Department into poverty preceding economic downturn

indicators.note: Heads of asks for the first letter of each following word in turn

parts.words: Department into poverty preceding economic downturn

explanation.surface: A government department's leaders were dragged into poverty ahead of a recession.
explanation.definitionFit: Dipped and plunged are synonyms for going down suddenly, as figures or a person into water.

clue.text: Stories about international airmen

indicators.note: about means the word for stories goes round the abbreviation

parts.note: plots are the storylines of tales

explanation.surface: Tales are told about pilots who fly worldwide routes.
explanation.definitionFit: Pilots are airmen, the people who fly aircraft.

clue.text: Wash small cheeky boy round back of ear

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels

indicators.note: round means the word for the boy goes around the letter from ear

parts.note: cub is an old word for a raw or impudent youth

indicators.note: back of takes the final letter of ear

explanation.surface: A mother tells a scamp to wash behind his ears.
explanation.walkthrough: CUB wraps round R, the last letter of ear, giving CRUB after S.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrub is to wash something hard by rubbing, so it stands for wash.

clue.text: Guts shown by Mum getting involved in matches

indicators.note: in places the jumbled letters inside the word for matches

parts.note: ties are matches or fixtures, as in cup ties

indicators.note: getting involved suggests the letters of Mum become tangled up

explanation.surface: Mum's belly shows when she turns up at sports fixtures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting involved' rearranges MUM to UMM, which goes inside TIES. A cup tie is a British term for a knockout football match.
explanation.definitionFit: Guts in the sense of bellies or stomachs; tummies is the informal word for them.

clue.text: Son caught monkey after effort initially to run away

indicators.note: after puts the son-caught-monkey string behind the opening letter
initially takes the first letter of effort

parts.note: C is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught
an ape is a kind of monkey in loose usage

explanation.surface: A boy grabs a monkey after it tries to bolt.
explanation.definitionFit: To escape is to get away or flee, matching run away as an infinitive.

clue.text: It's out in a strange place

indicators.note: strange suggests the letters before it are put into an odd new order

parts.note: the letters I, T, S, without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that it has come out somewhere odd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strange' looks like it describes place, but it rearranges ITS OUT IN A.
explanation.definitionFit: A situation is a position or location, so it can mean place.

clue.text: A terrorist at first invites shots

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letter of terrorist

parts.note: to tempt is to invite or entice

explanation.surface: A gunman issues an invitation to open fire.
explanation.definitionFit: A shot is an attempt, as in having a shot at something, so attempts means shots.

clue.text: Times quoting E-lister initially on the front — sensational!

indicators.note: on the front places that letter at the start of the rest
initially asks for the opening letter of the hyphenated celebrity word

parts.note: X is the multiplication sign, read as times
citing a source means quoting it

explanation.surface: A newspaper puts a minor celebrity on its front page in a lurid splash.
explanation.walkthrough: The Times looks like the newspaper, but it is the times sign X.
explanation.definitionFit: Something exciting is thrilling or sensational, as in a thrilling headline.

clue.text: Faithful travellers

parts.note: people of religious faith who journey to a holy place

explanation.definitionFit: Pilgrims are believers who travel to sacred sites, so they are travellers moved by faith.

clue.text: Vinyl record's crackling still

definitions.meaning: the hiss and crackle on old records, caused by electric charge and dust

explanation.definitionFit: Static is electrical interference noise, and as an adjective it means unmoving.

clue.text: Demonstrate in what manner to carry son

parts.note: how asks in what manner

explanation.surface: A father is shown how to carry his boy.
explanation.walkthrough: HOW carries S, here at its front.
explanation.definitionFit: To show is to demonstrate, both meaning to make something plain to see.

clue.text: Fix his tables when broken

indicators.note: when broken suggests the letters are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: Someone mends a man's tables after they break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fix' reads as repair, but the definition means set up or settle.
explanation.definitionFit: To establish a fact or date is to fix it firmly, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Boy and father returned to confess

indicators.note: returned means the boy-and-father string is read backwards

parts.note: Tim is a boy's name
da is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: A son and his dad came back to own up.
explanation.walkthrough: TIM then DA read backwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To admit a fault is to confess it, own up to it.

clue.text: Exercises with energy on board American ship

indicators.note: on board means the letter is carried inside the ship's prefix

parts.note: USS, United States Ship, prefixes US Navy vessels
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Sailors work out energetically aboard a US warship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exercises' is a verb: puts to use, as one exercises a right.
explanation.definitionFit: To exercise a power is to use it, so exercises and uses are synonyms.

clue.text: One keeps a low profile in the main, perhaps

definitions.text: One keeps a low profile in the main, perhaps

parts.words: One keeps a low profile in the main, perhaps
parts.note: reads as someone who mostly stays out of sight, but the main is the sea and the low profile is being underwater

explanation.definitionFit: A submarine travels below the surface of the sea, the main, keeping literally low.

clue.text: Recorded tit horribly getting caught by another bird

indicators.note: caught by means the jumbled letters are held inside the other bird

parts.note: a wren is a small bird, like the tit

indicators.note: horribly suggests the letters of tit are mangled

explanation.surface: Notes were taken of a tit being savagely seized by a different bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horribly' turns TIT into ITT, which goes inside WREN.
explanation.definitionFit: Something written has been put down on paper, that is recorded.

clue.text: They are often taken on field trips

definitions.text: They are often taken on field trips

parts.words: They are often taken on field trips
parts.note: sounds like school outings, but means farm vehicles driven across fields

explanation.definitionFit: Tractors are farm vehicles that travel across fields, making many trips to and fro.

clue.text: One entering church?

indicators.note: entering means the numeral goes inside the word for a large church

parts.note: a minster is a large or important church
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A question about who might go into a church.
explanation.walkthrough: I goes inside MINSTER; the whole clue also describes a cleric going into a church.
explanation.definitionFit: A minister is a member of the clergy, someone who goes into church to lead worship.

clue.text: Freshwater fish — a brown? I get corrected

indicators.note: get corrected suggests the letters before it must be put right, reordered

explanation.surface: An angler's catch is misidentified as a brown trout and set straight.
explanation.walkthrough: A BROWN I rearranged gives the answer, a trout like the brown trout in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The rainbow trout is a common freshwater game fish.

clue.text: Fellow in kitchen grabs a little sleep

indicators.note: grabs means the run of letters is caught inside the words before it

explanation.surface: A man in the kitchen snatches a quick nap.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across fellOW IN Kitchen, as in forty winks.
explanation.definitionFit: A wink of sleep is a brief nap, as in not sleeping a wink or forty winks.

clue.text: Round of applause for worker

definitions.meaning: as in give someone a big ovation
a labourer, as in a farm worker

explanation.definitionFit: To give a big hand is to applaud, and a hand is a manual labourer.

clue.text: Port from bar drunk in 60 minutes

indicators.note: in places the jumbled letters inside the time period

parts.note: an hour is sixty minutes

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters of bar are reeling

explanation.surface: A sailor leaves a bar tipsy within the hour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' rearranges BAR to ARB, which goes inside HOUR.
explanation.definitionFit: A harbour is a port, a sheltered place where ships dock.

clue.text: Daughter with four fish to share

parts.note: IV is four in Roman numerals
the ide is a freshwater fish, a crossword regular

explanation.surface: A girl splits four fish to share them out.
explanation.definitionFit: To divide something is to share it out among people.

clue.text: View snake twisting etc

parts.note: the asp is a venomous snake

indicators.note: twisting suggests the letters of etc are wound into a new order

explanation.surface: A sight of a snake writhing and so on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twisting' turns ETC into ECT after ASP.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspect is a view, as in a house with a southern aspect.

clue.text: Country some reach in Asia

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of a land lies within reach in Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across reaCH IN Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: China is a country in East Asia.

clue.text: Where little ones may be planted in the morning?

definitions.text: Where little ones may be planted in the morning?

parts.words: Where little ones may be planted in the morning?
parts.note: reads as parents dropping young children off for the day, but also places where young plants are grown

explanation.definitionFit: Nurseries are both day centres for toddlers and gardens where seedlings are raised.

clue.text: Leaves building site around ten

indicators.note: around means the rebuilt letters go round the numeral
building suggests the letters of site are constructed into a new form

parts.note: X is ten in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A worker walks off a construction site at about ten o'clock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'building' rearranges SITE to EITS, which goes around X.
explanation.definitionFit: Exits as a verb means leaves, goes out.

clue.text: Reveal highly attractive dress

parts.note: to out someone is to reveal a secret about them
fit is British slang for sexy, highly attractive

explanation.surface: A revealing, very sexy frock is on show.
explanation.walkthrough: FIT as British slang means good-looking.
explanation.definitionFit: An outfit is a set of clothes, a dress or costume.

clue.text: Certain pressure before I vote is wrong

indicators.note: before puts the symbol ahead of the rearranged letters

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure

indicators.note: wrong suggests the letters before it are out of order

explanation.surface: Someone under pressure fears their ballot is mistaken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' rearranges I VOTE IS to OSITIVE, after P.
explanation.definitionFit: Positive means sure, as in I am positive it was him, so it equals certain.

clue.text: In front of son, Ballesteros, holding driver finally, puts the ball into play

indicators.note: In front of puts the name-plus-letter string ahead of the abbreviation
holding means the golfer's name contains the letter

parts.note: Seve Ballesteros was a famous Spanish golfer

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of driver

explanation.surface: Ahead of his boy, the golfer, gripping his driver, sends the ball off.
explanation.walkthrough: SEVE holds R, the last of driver, to give SERVE; S follows. The surface is golf but the definition is tennis.
explanation.definitionFit: In tennis a player serves to put the ball into play.

clue.text: View coppers fighting with head of thugs

indicators.note: fighting suggests the letters of coppers are brawling into a new order
head of takes the first letter of thugs

explanation.surface: A scene of police brawling, with a gang leader among them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fighting' rearranges COPPERS to PROSPEC, and T ends it.
explanation.definitionFit: A prospect is a view, as in a fine prospect of the hills.
